products.name: Promptfoo
products.note: Open-source prompt testing and red-teaming; declarative YAML test cases with deterministic assertions and LLM-graded checks; CI-first

profile_text.body:
Promptfoo is a software company that describes itself as an AI security platform focused on catching vulnerabilities during development. According to its website, the platform is trusted by 156 of the Fortune 500 and more than 300,000 developers worldwide, with stated customers spanning healthcare, telecommunications, retail, and enterprise software sectors.

The company's core product, also called Promptfoo, is an open-source prompt testing and red-teaming tool. It uses declarative YAML test cases with deterministic assertions and LLM-graded checks, and is designed to integrate into CI/CD pipelines. The site states it covers more than 50 vulnerability types, including prompt injection and jailbreaks, and is built to test application-level concerns such as business logic, retrieval-augmented generation, agents, and integrations, rather than model-level testing alone. The company emphasizes that the tool scales from one to more than 100 applications without requiring manual scenario writing.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
